description: This file defines the PrivilegedRequest class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including nested Descriptor and Connection classes, for managing privileged socket-based communication, including socket creation, request handling, and descriptor passing on UNIX-like systems.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest
classes.description: Main class providing privileged socket request handling, including opening, closing, and requesting operations.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a socket descriptor with move semantics and resource management.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Handles socket connection states, including opening, requesting, listening, reading, and writing socket data, with descriptor passing capabilities.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection with a given identifier.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Performs a privileged request over the socket, passing descriptors.

methods.name: Service
methods.description: Virtual method intended to be overridden to handle service-specific logic for incoming requests.
